note: The legacy direct-write tail (dispatch_into, vespera_dispatch_into, dispatchDirect0) refuses a text/event-stream response with a bounded 500 instead of draining a stream that may never end. vespera_core: Operation, MediaType, Encoding, Parameter, Header, Example, RequestBody, Response and SecurityScheme refuse a repeated key again (duplicate field), and a $ref key in a callback map is refused. vespera: multipart part-name echo escapes the Arabic letter mark, Mongolian vowel separator, word joiner, byte order mark and other format controls. vespera_jni: a resumable DIRECT dispatch that does not fit the minimum buffer zeroes the stash handle area.
